assumptions.model: Official FR3 kinematics and limits, deterministic new 33-sphere fit to official collision meshes; not the original unreleased sphere centers/radii or collision filters.
assumptions.random_inputs: Original seeds, poses and obstacle radii/distribution unpublished. Fixed 0..9 seeds and the above workspace distributions before final runs. Goal poses generated by FK of independently sampled collision-free left-side configurations; pose IK is still solved and audited.
assumptions.velocity_acceleration: Unit per-joint bounds as released example/hardware section; simulation limits and Bezier degree unpublished.
assumptions.nto: Real Drake MinimumDistanceLowerBoundConstraint, default 0.01 influence offset, zero distance bound, uniform Nc. Time controls are arclength-resampled from DRM nodes with a minimum of 8 to retain detour degrees of freedom under rest endpoint constraints; minimum count and warm start are unpublished. This v3 choice follows structural diagnosis of the preserved v2 minimum-4 profile, before v3 runs; no tuning to published outcomes.
assumptions.solvers: LSCS Clarabel substitutes for unlicensed MOSEK. LGCS exact Gurobi MISOCP; restricted-license failures retained. Native wheel and solver versions postdate paper.
assumptions.budget: 60s solver limit and 240s case watchdog are reconstruction limits, not values supplied by paper.
assumptions.validation: Dense independent Drake checks with bounded step; no continuous collision certificate. Known-invalid DRM seeds are not inflated; NTO still receives them as warm starts. Native DRM success and independently valid DRM success are reported separately.
